gloss: poster; contributor; person who submits a post or article

definitions.gloss: poster; contributor; person who submits a post, comment, or article
definitions.explanation: The person who writes and submits a post, comment, photo, or article to a magazine, newspaper, bulletin board, blog, or social media platform. Originally used of readers contributing to print publications; now the default word for someone who posts content online.

examples.japanese: {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伏|ふ}せられている→伏せる：11515_fuseru⟧。
examples.english: The poster's name has been withheld.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦{在住|ざいじゅう}→在住：12052_zaijuu⟧らしい。
examples.english: The person who posted this photo apparently lives in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪質|あくしつ}→悪質：20553_akushitsu⟧な⟦コメント→コメント：06956_komento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アカウント→アカウント：05103_akaunto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{凍結|とうけつ}→凍結：09613_touketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The management decided to freeze the accounts of posters who repeatedly made malicious comments.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧ ('to post; to submit a contribution') and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ ('person'). A {投稿者|とうこうしゃ} is literally 'one who posts'.

USAGE:
- Neutral term with no positive or negative connotation on its own; context usually supplies the evaluation (e.g., ⟦{悪質|あくしつ}→悪質：20553_akushitsu⟧な{投稿者|とうこうしゃ} 'malicious poster', ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧{投稿者|とうこうしゃ} 'regular contributor').
- Appears on websites and in apps as a generic label for the author of a piece of user-generated content (photo, review, comment, question).
- When referring to one's own post, speakers use ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ or ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧ rather than calling themselves {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: the poster's name
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧: the poster himself/herself
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧: to identify the poster
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}: anonymous poster
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}: regular contributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to post; to submit — the verb the noun is derived from.
- ⟦{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}→寄稿者：22699_kikousha⟧: contributor (to a magazine or publication) — more formal; used of writers invited to submit articles to a specific publication.
- {発信者|はっしんしゃ}: sender; originator (of a message or information) — broader, covering anyone who sends or emits a communication.
- ⟦ユーザー→ユーザー：05393_yuuzaa⟧: user — covers anyone using a service; narrower than {投稿者|とうこうしゃ} since not all users post content.
